title: Constructed consecutive scalar comparison after inverse image
statement: Let g:Z→X and h:Z→T be scheme morphisms, d an adic coefficient datum on A and n a natural number [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum, def-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-etale-descent-data]. Define lisseTowerNormalizedScalarSquare by the unique witness of [lem-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-scalar-restriction]; it satisfies LisseTowerScalarSquareSections. Localizing this square gives lisseTowerFixedScalarIso. Pasting it with localIsomorphismProEtaleCoefficients for h [def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf] and the actual restriction compositor constructs lisseTowerPulledScalarIso: Res(q_n)⋙(h*⋙F_(n+1))⋙H_(n+1) ≅ (h*⋙F_n)⋙H_n. Here F_j=lisseTowerFixedRealization(g,d,j), H_j=pbcDerivedRestrict(constantAdicFiniteProjection(g,d,j)) [def-weil-pbc-constant-adic-finite-diagram-data]. No tower, descended level or normalization arrow is an input.

proof.text: Take the unique normalized ordinary square from lisseTower_scalar_restriction. Its first specified property is LisseTowerScalarSquareSections. The data are uniquely determined by the theorem, including its further reflection and local-universality properties.

Conjugate mapDerivedCategorySquareIso of the ordinary square by lisseTowerFixedRealizationIso. Whisker the inverse-image coefficient mate on the right with F_(n+1), paste the localized square and reassociate. Whisker with H_(n+1), then apply pbcDerivedRestrictComp for the pulled finite quotient and completion projection. Its ring-map identity is constantAdicFiniteProjection_comp. This explicitly constructs the required natural isomorphism.
